verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no workspace export feature, let alone one that preserves comments, attachments, and audit trails. The Asana/Jira import claims describe migrating data into ClickUp, not exporting it out. API endpoints for comments and attachments are developer building blocks that earn no credit toward a first-party export capability.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
